shared_information_rule: Defensive facts and derived defensive components are canonical shared football-state inputs. Fantasy, DST, player matchup, spread, total and player-prop engines may transform them differently but may not maintain contradictory independent versions of the same fact.
anti_double_count_rule: A defensive effect already represented in the shared team-defense state may not be applied again as a direct player matchup penalty or bonus unless the decomposition explicitly removes the overlapping team-level contribution.
market_isolation_rule: Sportsbook spreads, totals, moneylines and player props are prohibited from building or calibrating the football defensive state. Market comparison remains downstream only.

composite_policy.rule: Do not assign hand-tuned or guessed weights to the component metrics. A single composite defensive rating remains null until leakage-safe historical calibration validates weights and out-of-sample behavior.

2026_adjustment_policy.rule: Verified 2026 personnel, coaching and availability changes attach to the same canonical defensive state but carry zero direct numeric adjustment authority until a deterministic authorized rule or validated coefficient exists.
